options.name: ag_name
options.description: Name of the Availability Group.

options.name: all_ags
options.description: Apply changes to all availability groups on the instance. Only used for configuring existing availability groups.

options.name: allow_null_backup
options.description: Allow taking a full backup to C(NULL) if one does not exist and I(seeding_mode=Automatic).

options.name: automated_backup_preference
options.description: How to handle backup requests by default.

options.name: availability_mode
options.description: Whether the replica should be Asynchronous or Synchronous. Only used in creating a new availability group.

options.name: basic_availability_group
options.description: Indicates whether the availability group is Basic Availability Group.

options.name: cluster_type
options.description: Cluster type of the Availability Group. Only supported in SQL Server 2017 and above.

options.name: contained_availability_group
options.description: Indicates whether the availability group is Contained. Requires DBATools >= 2.1.15

options.name: database
options.description: Name of the database to create the Availability Group for.

options.name: database_health_trigger
options.description: Indicates whether the availability group triggers the database health.

options.name: dtc_support_enabled
options.description: Enables Dtc support.

options.name: failover_mode
options.description: Whether the replica have Automatic or Manual failover.

options.name: failure_condition_level
options.description: Specifies the different conditions that can trigger an automatic failover in Availability Group.

options.name: force
options.description: Drop and recreate the database on remote servers using fresh backup.

options.name: healthcheck_timeout
options.description: This setting used to specify the length of time, in milliseconds, that the SQL Server resource DLL should wait for information returned by the C(sp_server_diagnostics) stored procedure before reporting the Always On Failover Cluster Instance (FCI) as unresponsive. Changes that are made to the timeout settings are effective immediately and do not require a restart of the SQL Server resource.

options.name: is_distributed_ag
options.description: Indicates whether the availability group is distributed.

options.name: seeding_mode
options.description: Default seeding mode for the replica. Should remain as the default otherwise manual setup may be required.

options.name: shared_path
options.description: The network share where the backups will be backed up and restored from.

options.name: sql_instance
options.description: The SQL Server instance to modify.

options.name: sql_instance_secondary
options.description: The secondary SQL Server instance for the new Availability Group.

options.name: sql_password
options.description: Password for SQL Authentication.

options.name: sql_password_secondary
options.description: Password for SQL Authentication for the secondary replica.

options.name: sql_username
options.description: Username for SQL Authentication.

options.name: sql_username_secondary
options.description: Username for SQL Authentication for the secondary replica.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether or not the object should be C(present) or C(absent).

options.name: use_last_backup
options.description: Use the last full and log backup of database. A log backup must be the last backup.
